_comment: Baseline of INHERITED DEBT for scripts/audit_stipulated_defs.py. Every entry is reviewed:false on purpose: these are asserted Props used as premises that the corpus discloses in prose but does not machine-enforce with a Stipulations.lean (diamond) entry. Listing them records the debt; it does NOT discharge it. A clean run means 'no NEW undisclosed bridge and the inherited set has not grown' -- never 'the corpus is clean'. Set reviewed:true only after checking the disclosure against the ledger pointer in `gapmap`. Generated 2026-09-26 from scripts/audit_stipulated_defs.py --report; the dependent lists are harvested from that run.
